d: Malaysia is investigating an alleged drug-smuggling network involving members of its Royal Malaysian Air Force. Authorities have identified 21 suspected transactions dating back to August 2024, with at least three tonnes of illegal drugs allegedly moved using military infrastructure. The consignments were valued at 156 million ringgit, or around $38 million. In this video, Firstpost examines how investigators uncovered the operation, the alleged role of an Air Force pilot, and the 13 arrests, including seven military personnel.
